excluded_targets.mistral_medium_3_openrouter: Preserved procurement full-load transport failure: 208/267 completion-run writer transports timed out.

execution.controls: Reuse the completed frozen GPT-OSS and DeepSeek isolation controls; make no new control calls.
execution.writer_routes: Run each writer as a separate route so each receives its own deterministic witness cap. Generate memories once and evaluate those exact memories with both executors.
execution.pressure_routes: After each complete writer route, validate and replay pressure from that exact source. Make zero writer calls and zero baseline reruns.
execution.run_order: Complete writer and exact-source pressure for each target before moving to the next target, in the frozen writer order.
execution.resampling: No outcome-based reruns, removals, replacements, or pooled target substitution.
execution.technical_failures: Preserve provider and route failures in the denominator and artifact record. Stop before the next writer if the remaining approved budget is insufficient.
execution.writer_command_template: python -m experiments.run --domain cybersecurity --corpus-version benchmark_v1 --presentation-version naturalistic_v1 --study writer --writer-targets {writer_target} --executor-targets gptoss_baseten,deepseek_baseten --writer-runs 1 --executor-runs 1 --writer-max-attempts 2 --capacity-tier primary --seed 20260812 --estimated-cost-usd {writer_and_baseline_estimate} --tag cybersecurity-v1-transfer-{writer_label}
execution.pressure_command_template: python -m experiments.run --domain cybersecurity --corpus-version benchmark_v1 --presentation-version naturalistic_v1 --study pressure --source-run {exact_writer_run} --estimated-cost-usd {pressure_estimate} --tag cybersecurity-v1-transfer-{writer_label}-pressure

analysis.primary_reporting: Report every writer-executor pair separately by condition and arm.
analysis.pooled_reporting: Pool only the five frozen reliable writer targets and retain writer-level sensitivity results.
analysis.mechanism: Report deterministic natural-error versus exact-repair trials, affected families, and memory-error mechanisms.
analysis.transfer: Pair executor decisions on the same memory and request; report marginal rates and paired agreement.
analysis.pressure: Pair baseline and exact-source pressure trials; separate unauthorized action from authorized use.
analysis.cross_domain: Compare percentages and family-level intervals with procurement; do not equate raw counts across domains.
